chunks: May well hope for the mercy of God; and God is full of mercy and grace.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God is described as 'Afwwan Ghafur'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific context of the Battle of Badr, offering hope for the pardon of those who repented after initially opposing the Prophet. It highlights the divine attribute of 'Afuw' (erasing the sin entirely) alongside 'Ghaffar' (covering the sin), encouraging believers to turn back to God with sincere repentance.
